para.text: An important feature of XYGRAPH3D is lighting. This simulates the effect of a lamp shining on the objects, making some faces lighter and other faces darker. This effect can make the appearance of objects and surfaces very realistic (photographic presentation). The figure (taken from an actual screen dump) shows a bar with frame but without lighting, a bar with frame and lighting, and a bar with lighting but without frame.

para.text: However this is also a simple simulation. Lighting will not cast any true shadows, and the sides facing away from the light source are still visible (not black).
